title: Defect and Damage Process
content: If a part arrives broken, cracked, or defective, start a defect claim within 14 days of delivery. Include photos of the damage and your order number. We offer a replacement or a full refund once the defect is confirmed by our quality team.

title: Shipping Policy
content: Standard orders ship within 3-5 business days via our freight partners. You will receive a tracking number by email once the order leaves the warehouse. Expedited shipping is available at checkout for an added fee.

title: Return Policy
content: Unused, unopened items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund minus a 10% restocking fee. Custom or made-to-order items are not eligible for return unless defective.

title: Lead Times
content: Custom manufacturing lead times run 4-6 weeks depending on order volume and material availability. Standard catalog items typically ship within 3-5 business days of order confirmation.

title: Quote Process
content: To request a custom quote, send us your specifications, quantity, and desired material. Quotes are typically returned within 2 business days and are valid for 30 days from issue.

title: Bulk Order Discounts
content: Orders over 500 units qualify for tiered volume discounts. Contact your account representative or request a quote with the full quantity to see applicable pricing tiers.

title: Payment Terms
content: New accounts are billed on a pro-forma basis (payment before shipment). Established accounts in good standing may qualify for net-30 terms after their first three completed orders.

title: International Shipping
content: We ship to most countries via international freight. Customs duties and import taxes are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in our quoted prices.

title: Rush Order Policy
content: Rush production is available on select items for a 25% surcharge, cutting standard lead time roughly in half. Rush eligibility depends on current production capacity, confirmed at time of order.

title: Warranty Policy
content: All manufactured parts carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects under normal use. Warranty does not cover damage from misuse, modification, or normal wear.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Orders can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of placement. After production has started, cancellation may incur a fee covering materials and labor already committed.

title: Product Customization Options
content: Most catalog items can be customized for material, finish, and dimensions within documented tolerances. Custom specifications outside standard tolerances require engineering review before quoting.

title: Tracking and Delivery Issues
content: If tracking shows no movement for more than 3 business days, or shows delivered but the order was not received, contact support with the order number so we can open a carrier trace.

title: Quality Certifications
content: Our facility is ISO 9001 certified. Certificates of conformance and material test reports are available on request for any order, typically provided with the shipment paperwork.

title: Contact and Escalation Policy
content: Standard inquiries are handled within 1 business day. Urgent issues involving safety, damaged shipments, or account billing disputes are escalated directly to a support lead for same-day review.
